response.original_title: How do I add someone to an already booked Viking Cruises?
response.overview: You must call Viking Cruises customer service directly +1-866-829-1280(US) or contact your travel agent to add someone to an existing booking, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. To add someone to an existing Viking Cruises booking, you must call Viking Customer Service directly +1-866-829-1280(US) or contact your travel agent, as this change cannot be completed online or through the mobile app. Your current stateroom must have the physical bed space (such as a sofa bed or Pullman bunk) to hold an extra person. The total ship and specific muster zone/lifeboat capacities cannot be completely full. If your room or zone is at maximum capacity, +1-866-829-1280(US) you may need to upgrade to a larger cabin or book a separate nearby room.
